This is the right constraint for shoulders, hips, the neck, and the ankles. In physics engine terms, it removes all three translational degrees of freedom but leaves three rotational degrees of freedom active, subject to angular limits.

html: 在实时渲染中，我们使用一种称为 _alpha 测试（有时称为 alpha 掩蔽）的技术来处理这种复杂性。我们没有用真实的几何形状对树上的每片叶子进行建模，而是采用一个宽阔、平坦的四边形并在其上绘制一片叶子 纹理 。纹理 带有一个 _alpha 通道 — 一个从 0 到 1 的值，表示每个纹素的不透明程度。在叶子的边缘，alpha 为零：透明，忽略该像素。在叶子的主体中，alpha 为 1：不透明，该像素存在。通过这个技巧，一个平面三角形可以代表一个令人信服的复杂轮廓。
source: In real-time rendering, we handle this complexity with a technique called __VT00002__alpha testing__VT00003__ (sometimes called alpha masking). Instead of modeling every leaf on a tree with real geometry, we take a broad, flat quadrilateral and paint a leaf __VT00000__ onto it. The __VT00001__ carries an __VT00004__alpha channel__VT00005__ — a value from zero to one that says how opaque each texel is. At the edges of the leaf, the alpha is zero: transparent, ignore this pixel. In the body of the leaf, the alpha is one: opaque, this pixel exists. With this trick, a single flat triangle can represent a convincingly complex silhouette.

html: 当您在布娃娃的所有身体部位之间启用完全碰撞检测时，模拟几乎立即变得不稳定。问题是几何重叠：在真实的人体中，相邻的身体部分共享体积。手臂与躯干接触。大腿与骨盆在髋窝处稍微重叠。脊柱节段相互贯通。这对于视觉目的来说很好——皮肤网格隐藏了所有这些——但物理引擎不知道皮肤。它会看到底层的碰撞形状，如果这些形状重叠，解算器会将重叠解释为穿透，必须使用大的分离力来解决。
source: When you enable full collision detection between all of a ragdoll’s body parts, the simulation becomes unstable almost immediately. The problem is geometric overlap: in a real human body, adjacent body segments share volume. The arm is in contact with the torso. The thigh overlaps slightly with the pelvis at the hip socket. The spine segments interpenetrate. This is fine for visual purposes—the skin mesh hides all of this—but the physics engine doesn’t know about the skin. It sees the underlying collision shapes, and if those shapes overlap, the solver interprets the overlap as a penetration that must be resolved with a large separating force.

html: 在数据管理方面，我们使用两种主要机制：统一缓冲区和推送常量。统一缓冲区是更大的只读内存块，可有效存储在许多绘制调用之间共享的数据，使其非常适合在多个对象之间保持不变的变换矩阵和照明信息。另一方面，推送常量较小（通常限制为 128 字节或更少），但对于频繁更改每个对象的数据（例如材质属性）来说速度更快，这使得它们非常适合我们的材质系统。
source: When it comes to data management, we use two primary mechanisms: uniform buffers and push constants. Uniform buffers are larger, read-only memory blocks that efficiently store data shared across many draw calls, making them perfect for transformation matrices and lighting information that remain constant across multiple objects. Push constants, on the other hand, are smaller (typically limited to 128 bytes or less) but much faster for frequently changing per-object data like material properties, making them ideal for our material system.

html: 胶囊是带有半球形盖的圆柱体。它是四肢的理想形状，因为它是旋转对称的、光滑的（这可以防止关节处出现隧道效应），并且只需要定义两个参数：半高和半径。物理引擎可以非常有效地执行胶囊与胶囊的碰撞检测。长骨——肱骨（上臂）、尺骨/桡骨（前臂）、股骨（大腿）、胫骨（胫骨）——都被胶囊很好地近似。

It is the ideal shape for limbs because it is rotationally symmetric, smooth (which prevents tunneling artifacts at joints), and requires only two parameters to define: a half-height and a radius. html: CAS 的工作原理如下：“仅当当前值与我的‘预期’值匹配时才更新此内存。”如果不匹配，则意味着另一个线程先更改了数据。在这种情况下，我们的线程必须使用新值“重试”操作。这种“循环直到成功”模式在高级无锁编程中很常见，并且比传统锁更有效，因为线程仅在存在实际争用时等待，并且它们永远不会离开硬件调度程序。
source: CAS works like this: "Only update this memory if its current value matches my 'expected' value." If it doesn’t match, it means another thread changed the data first. In that case, our thread must "retry" the operation with the new value. This "loop until success" pattern is common in advanced lock-free programming and is much more efficient than a traditional lock because threads only wait if there is actual contention, and they never leave the hardware scheduler.

html: _Synapse_ 是一个神经元的轴突末端和另一个神经元的树突之间的间隙。这是信号从一个神经元传递到下一个神经元的地方。有趣的是，神经元实际上并不相互接触——突触处有一个微小的间隙。当电信号到达轴突末端时，它会触发化学信使（神经递质）的释放，这些化学信使漂浮在这个间隙上并与下一个神经元树突上的受体结合。这种化学通讯对于大脑的运作至关重要。
source: The __VT00000__Synapse__VT00001__ is the gap between one neuron’s Axon Terminal and another neuron’s Dendrite. This is where signals pass from one neuron to the next. Interestingly, neurons don’t actually touch each other—there’s a tiny gap at the synapse. When an electrical signal reaches the end of an axon, it triggers the release of chemical messengers (neurotransmitters) that float across this gap and bind to receptors on the next neuron’s dendrites. This chemical communication is crucial for how the brain works.

html: 第一种方法通常用于绘制透明对象，因为与顺序无关的透明度是一个很难解决的挑战。然而，按深度对片段排序的问题更常见的是使用深度缓冲区来解决。深度缓冲区是一个附加附件，它存储每个位置的深度，就像颜​​色附件存储每个位置的颜色一样。每次光栅化器产生一个片段时，深度测试都会检查新片段是否比前一个片段更近。如果不是，则丢弃新片段。通过深度测试的片段将其自己的深度写入深度缓冲区。可以从 片段着色器 操纵该值，就像操纵颜色输出一样。
source: The first approach is commonly used for drawing transparent objects, because order-independent transparency is a difficult challenge to solve. However, the problem of ordering fragments by depth is much more commonly solved using a __VT00001__depth buffer__VT00002__. A depth buffer is an additional attachment that stores the depth for every position just like the color attachment stores the color of every position. Every time the rasterizer produces a fragment, the depth test will check if the new fragment is closer than the previous one. If it isn’t, then the new fragment is discarded. A fragment that passes the depth test writes its own depth to the depth buffer. It is possible to manipulate this value from the __VT00000__, just like you can manipulate the color output.

html: 还有一个更微妙的缓存优势。当来自附近像素的 16 条阴影光线全部测试相同的叶子三角形时（它们倾向于这样做，因为附近的像素看到附近的几何体），这些三角形的微贴图数据在 GPU 的 L1 和 L2 缓存中已经是前几条光线的热值。后续光线的微图查找在内存方面几乎是免费的。相比之下，每次都需要获取 alpha 纹理，并且考虑到不同光线的 UV 坐标可能不同，它不太可能保持温暖。
source: There is also a subtler cache benefit at play. When 16 shadow rays from nearby pixels all test the same leaf triangles (which they tend to do, since nearby pixels see nearby geometry), the micromap data for those triangles is already warm in the GPU’s L1 and L2 caches from the first few rays. The micromap lookup for subsequent rays is nearly free in memory terms. The alpha __VT00000__, by contrast, would need to be fetched every time and is less likely to stay warm given the potentially varying UV coordinates of different rays.

html: _Opacity Micromaps (OMM) 是 Vulkan 对这个问题的答案，通过 VK_KHR_opacity_micromap 扩展提供。核心思想很优雅，一旦理解，几乎是显而易见的：我们不是强迫 GPU 在运行时发现每个三角形每个部分的不透明度，而是在绘制第一帧之前将该信息预先烘焙到 GPU 的 加速结构 中。我们将每个三角形细分为微小的微三角形网格，并将每个三角形分类为永久不透明、永久透明或边缘情况未知。硬件遍历单元直接读取该分类，而不运行任何 着色器 代码，并立即决定光线是否被阻挡。
source: __VT00003__Opacity Micromaps (OMMs)__VT00004__ are Vulkan’s answer to this problem, delivered through the __VT00000__ extension. The core idea is elegant and, once understood, almost obvious: rather than forcing the GPU to discover the opacity of each part of each triangle at runtime, we pre-bake that information into the GPU’s __VT00001__ before the first frame is ever drawn. We subdivide each triangle into a grid of tiny __VT00005__micro-triangles__VT00006__ and classify each one as permanently opaque, permanently transparent, or edge-case unknown. The hardware traversal unit reads this classification directly, without running any __VT00002__ code, and makes instant decisions about whether a ray is blocked.

html: 这是 sigmoid 的问题：对于大的正或负输入，它的梯度非常小。当远离零时（例如，x = 10 或 x = -10），S 形曲线几乎平坦，因此其导数接近零。在反向传播过程中，这些微小的梯度在网络中向后流动时会相乘。在具有多层的深层网络中，您将许多小数相乘，梯度实际上消失了——变得如此之小以至于学习停止。
source: Here’s the problem with sigmoid: its gradient is very small for large positive or negative inputs. When you’re far from zero (say, at x = 10 or x = -10), the sigmoid curve is nearly flat, so its derivative approaches zero. During backpropagation, these tiny gradients get multiplied together as they flow backward through the network. In a deep network with many layers, you’re multiplying many small numbers together, and the gradient effectively vanishes—becoming so small that learning stops.

html: 变形目标在现代 GPU 硬件上可以快速评估，因为它们具有令人尴尬的并行性：每个顶点都是独立的，并且每个顶点的工作只是每个活动目标的一些乘加运算。瓶颈几乎总是内存带宽——从 GPU 内存获取位移数组——而不是算术。这就是为什么“剔除非活动目标”步骤很重要：如果您有 60 个变形目标，但此帧中只有 8 个非零目标，则调度 8 个活动目标而不是 60 个目标会减少 7.5 倍的带宽。
source: Morph targets are fast to evaluate on modern GPU hardware because they are embarrassingly parallel: each vertex is independent, and the work per vertex is just a few multiply-add operations per active target. The bottleneck is almost always memory bandwidth—fetching the displacement arrays from GPU memory—not arithmetic. This is why the "cull inactive targets" step matters: if you have 60 morph targets but only 8 are nonzero this frame, dispatching with 8 active targets rather than 60 reduces the bandwidth by 7.5x.

To answer that question, it must look up the alpha __VT00002__ at the exact point of intersection. And it must do this for every triangle the ray might pass through. This immediately shows you the "territory" of each bone—which region of the mesh each bone primarily controls—and makes joint boundary errors obvious. html: NonUniformResourceIndex 注释是使无绑定索引正确的关键部分。如果没有它，GPU 驱动程序可能会假设一个 Wave 中的所有线程（一组以锁步方式执行的线程）正在访问相同的描述符索引，当在同一调度中对不同的字符进行剥皮时，这将是不正确的。NonUniformResourceIndex 告诉编译器在索引上发出 NonUniform 装饰，指示硬件执行非均匀 纹理/缓冲区获取，以正确处理每个线程的变化。
source: The __VT00000__ annotation is the critical piece that makes the bindless indexing correct. Without it, the GPU driver may assume all threads in a wave (a group of threads that execute in lockstep) are accessing the same descriptor index—which would be incorrect when different characters are being skinned in the same dispatch. __VT00001__ tells the compiler to emit a __VT00002__ decoration on the index, which instructs the hardware to perform a non-uniform __VT00003__/buffer fetch that handles the per-thread variation correctly.

html: Vulkan 将您的 3D 场景渲染到特殊的 纹理 — 该场景分配有外部内存支持，以便 OpenCL 可以访问它。渲染完成后，Vulkan 会发出 信号量 信号。OpenCL 一直在等待 信号量，醒来并告诉 ONNX 运行时“数据已准备好”。ONNX 运行时直接在共享的 纹理 上运行推理 - 无需复制到 CPU，也无需上传回 GPU。当推理完成时，OpenCL 会发出另一个 信号量 信号。Vulkan 在使用结果之前会等待 信号量。
source: Vulkan renders your 3D scene to a special __VT00000__—one that’s allocated with external memory support so OpenCL can access it. When rendering finishes, Vulkan signals a __VT00001__. OpenCL, which has been waiting on that __VT00002__, wakes up and tells ONNX Runtime "the data is ready." ONNX Runtime runs inference directly on that shared __VT00003__—no copying to CPU, no uploading back to GPU. When inference completes, OpenCL signals another __VT00004__. Vulkan waits on that __VT00005__ before using the results.

html: 业界的面部动画解决方案是_morph Targets_，也称为_blend Shapes_或_shape keys_，具体取决于您使用的软件包。这个想法很简单：您不需要存储关节旋转的动画，而是存储代表不同面部表情的多个完整的顶点位置集。“微笑”变形目标存储微笑配置中每个面部顶点的位置。“眉毛抬起”变形目标将它们存储在抬起眉毛的配置中。在运行时，您可以通过对每个目标的贡献进行加权来在基础网格和一个或多个变形目标之间进行线性混合。如果微笑权重为 0.7，则每个顶点从其静止位置移动 70% 到其微笑位置。如果微笑（权重 0.5）和扬眉（权重 0.8）同时处于活动状态，则会添加位移，并且顶点会移动到组合位置。
source: The industry’s solution for facial animation is __VT00000__morph targets__VT00001__, which are also called __VT00002__blend shapes__VT00003__ or __VT00004__shape keys__VT00005__ depending on which software package you are using. The idea is straightforward: instead of animating joint rotations, you store multiple complete sets of vertex positions representing different facial expressions. A "smile" morph target stores the positions of every face vertex in the smiled configuration. A "brow raise" morph target stores them in the raised-brow configuration. At runtime, you blend linearly between the base mesh and one or more morph targets by weighting each target’s contribution. If the smile weight is 0.7, every vertex moves 70% of the way from its rest position to its smile position. If both a smile (weight 0.5) and a brow raise (weight 0.8) are active simultaneously, the displacements are added and the vertex moves to the combined position.

html: 更准确（也更复杂）的方法是根据动画的关节速度数据计算每个骨骼的速度。许多动画系统都会跟踪每个关节的变化率，您可以使用它来独立初始化每个骨骼体的角速度 - 为手臂提供自己的摆动动量，而不是均匀的根速度。这会产生更真实的布娃娃，特别是对于充满活力的动画中的角色，但需要更多的工作才能正确实现。
source: A more accurate (and more complex) approach is to compute per-bone velocities from the animation’s joint velocity data. Many animation systems track the rate of change of each joint, and you can use that to initialize each bone body’s angular velocity independently—giving the arms their own swing momentum rather than uniform root velocity. This produces more realistic ragdolls, especially for characters in the middle of vigorous animations, but requires more work to implement correctly.

html: FABRIK 由 Andreas Aristidou 和 Joan Lasenby 于 2011 年发布，它很快就产生了影响力，因为它在许多场景下在视觉上优于 CCD，而且实现起来非常简单。核心思想是将每个关节视为空间中的一个点，将每个骨骼视为连接两个连续点的刚性杆。给定末端执行器的目标，FABRIK 分两个阶段沿链重新分布关节：后向阶段，将末端执行器锚定在目标处，并将链传播到根部；前向阶段，将根部重新锚定在其原始位置，并将链传播回末端执行器。重复这两个阶段可以快速收敛到一个解决方案。
source: FABRIK was published by Andreas Aristidou and Joan Lasenby in 2011, and it became influential quickly because it is both visually superior to CCD in many scenarios and remarkably simple to implement. The core idea is to treat each joint as a point in space and each bone as a rigid rod connecting two consecutive points. Given a target for the end effector, FABRIK redistributes the joints along the chain in two phases: a backward phase that anchors the end effector at the target and propagates the chain toward the root, and a forward phase that re-anchors the root at its original position and propagates back toward the end effector. Repeating these two phases rapidly converges to a solution.

html: 当光线进入 BVH 时，它首先测试顶层边界框。如果未命中，则完成 - 光线不会击中整个场景中的任何物体。如果它击中了，它就会打开那个盒子并测试孩子们。它会跟随它击中的那些，并忽略它错过的那些。遍历以几何方式缩小：光线不是测试一百万个三角形，而是测试可能几十个边界框，并可能到达少数候选三角形。这就是光线遍历实时可行的原因。
source: When a ray enters the BVH, it first tests the top-level bounding box. If it misses, done — the ray hits nothing in the entire scene. If it hits, it opens that box and tests the children. It follows the ones it hits and ignores the ones it misses. The traversal narrows geometrically: rather than testing a million triangles, the ray tests perhaps a few dozen bounding boxes and reaches perhaps a handful of candidate triangles. This is why ray traversal is feasible in real time.

html: 让我们回顾一下我们实施的内容。我们从两种基本的 IK 算法开始：CCD 和 FABRIK。CCD 逐个关节工作，旋转每个关节以使末端执行器逐渐靠近目标，并针对具有严格关节限制的短链快速收敛。FABRIK 考虑的是位置而不是旋转，更均匀地重新分配链条，并且对于更长的链条和全臂伸展来说往往看起来更自然。两者都与场景图的脏标志系统集成：它们读取世界矩阵、计算校正并写回局部旋转。
source: Let’s review what we implemented. We started with the two fundamental IK algorithms: CCD and FABRIK. CCD works joint by joint, rotating each one to bring the end effector incrementally closer to the target, and converges quickly for short chains with tight joint limits. FABRIK thinks in terms of positions rather than rotations, redistributes the chain more evenly, and tends to look more natural for longer chains and full-arm reaching. Both integrate with the scene graph’s dirty-flag system: they read world matrices, compute corrections, and write back local rotations.

source: Android is worth calling out for the opposite reason: it isn’t that a compositor happens to be running and getting in the way, it’s that Android’s display model doesn’t have a "no compositor" mode to switch to in the first place. There is no code path on stock Android for an application to ask for raw display-plane access the way this chapter’s __VT00002__ does. html: VK_KHR_display 背后的原理在每个支持它的平台上都是相同的：使用它的应用程序要求成为显示器扫描输出硬件的唯一所有者，并且操作系统一次只会将该所有权授予一个进程。无论什么已经在绘制你的桌面——Linux 上的 Wayland 或 X11 合成器、Windows 上的桌面合成器、macOS 上完全支持它的窗口服务器——都已经拥有了该所有权，仅仅因为它是当前在显示器上放置像素的东西。没有任何操作系统可以让第二个不相关的应用程序介入并从已经驱动它的进程中接管显示；如果可能的话，任何应用程序都可以劫持您的屏幕，使其远离您正在做的任何事情，而这正是每个桌面操作系统的显示模型旨在防止的事情。
source: The principle behind __VT00000__ is the same on every platform that supports it: an application using it is asking to become the sole owner of a display’s scanout hardware, and an operating system will only ever grant that ownership to one process at a time. Whatever is already drawing your desktop - a Wayland or X11 compositor on Linux, the desktop compositor on Windows, the window server on macOS where it’s supported at all - already holds that ownership, simply by virtue of being the thing currently putting pixels on your monitor. There is no OS where a second, unrelated application can walk in and take over a display out from under the process already driving it; if that were possible, any application could hijack your screen away from whatever you were doing, which is exactly the kind of thing every desktop operating system’s display model is designed to prevent.

html: 位置校正的核心技术是逆运动学，缩写为IK。标准关键帧动画的工作原理是向前运动学：您设置关节旋转，末端执行器（手、脚）最终会到达数学放置的任何位置。IK 的工作原理相反：您指定末端执行器 _must_ 所在的位置，算法会计算将其放置在那里所需的关节旋转。这不是一个简单的反演——对于具有多个关节的链，通常有无限多个有效解决方案，并且算法必须选择看起来最自然的一个。
source: The central technique for positional correction is __VT00000__Inverse Kinematics__VT00001__, abbreviated IK. Standard keyframe animation works __VT00002__forward kinematically__VT00003__: you set joint rotations, and the end effector (the hand, the foot) ends up wherever the math puts it. IK works in reverse: you specify where the end effector __VT00004__must__VT00005__ be, and the algorithm computes the joint rotations required to put it there. This is not a trivial inversion—for a chain with multiple joints, there are typically infinitely many valid solutions, and the algorithm must pick the one that looks most natural.

html: 锁步模型有一个严重的弱点：_divergence_。当 warp 中的不同线程需要采用不同的代码路径时（当某些线程发现不透明命中而其他线程发现透明命中时），warp 无法保持同步。它必须执行两个代码路径，屏蔽每个路径上不活动的线程。一半的经线等待，而另一半则运行其分支，反之亦然。有效并行度减半，甚至更糟。
source: The lockstep model has a critical weakness: __VT00000__divergence__VT00001__. When different threads in a warp need to take different code paths — when some threads find an opaque hit and others find a transparent hit — the warp cannot stay in lockstep. It must execute both code paths, masking off the threads that aren’t active on each path. Half the warp waits while the other half runs its branch, then vice versa. The effective parallelism halves, or worse.

html: 问题？当 GPU 进行推理时，您的 CPU 处于空闲状态。当相机等待下一个请求时，GPU 处于空闲状态。如果推理需要 30 毫秒，渲染需要 5 毫秒，那么您的帧率为 28 FPS，并且这是假设 _nothing_ else 正在发生。更糟糕的是，你的 UI 会感觉“紧张”，因为主线程在等待 GPU 时被阻塞。
source: The problem? While the GPU is doing inference, your CPU is sitting idle. While the camera is waiting for the next request, the GPU is idle. html: _Morton Coding_：我们将 3D 位置映射到 1D 空间填充曲线 （_Z 曲线）。这是通过 交错 X、Y 和 Z 坐标的位 来完成的。例如，如果 X 为 010，Y 为 101，则 Morton 代码将为 011001（0 来自 X[0]，1 来自 Y[0]，1 来自 X[1]，0 来自 Y[1] 等）。此映射具有神奇的属性，即 3D 空间中接近的点将在 1D 空间中接近，从而有效地将 3D 层次结构“展平”为排序列表。

This is done by __VT00009__interleaving the bits__VT00010__ of the X, Y, and Z coordinates. For example, if X is __VT00000__ and Y is __VT00001__, the Morton code would be __VT00002__ (0 from X[0], 1 from Y[0], 1 from X[1], 0 from Y[1] etc). This mapping has the magical property that points that are close in 3D space will be close in 1D space, effectively "flattening" the 3D hierarchy into a sorted list.

We will tag each __VT00000__ (and any other transient resource, like our staging buffers) with the exact __VT00001__ at which it was last used. Our __VT00002__ function will then query the current __VT00003__ value. If the GPU has already reached or passed the tagged value, we can delete the resource immediately. source: The __VT00000__ function is invoked for every vertex. The built-in __VT00001__ annotated variable in the parameters contains the index of the current vertex. This is usually an index into the __VT00005__, but in our case, it will be an index into a hardcoded array of vertex data. The position of each vertex is accessed from the constant array in the __VT00006__ and combined with dummy __VT00002__ and __VT00003__ components to produce a position in clip coordinates. The built-in annotation __VT00004__ marks the output in the VertexOutput struct. Something worth mentioning if you’re familiar with other shading languages like GLSL or HLSL, there are no instructions for bindings. This is a feature of Slang. Slang is designed to automatically infer the bindings by the order of declaration. The struct for positions is a static to inform the compiler that we don’t need any bindings in our __VT00007__. Studious observers will notice that we’re calling our main function vertMain instead of main, this is because Slang and SPIR-V both support having multiple entry points in one file. This is important when you’re dealing with pipelines which have more than just a single vert/frag __VT00008__ combo. Ray-tracing for instance, for even simple demos would have four or more shaders all small yet needing their own file which can become cumbersome. Another major feature of Slang is the ability to create __VT00009__ libraries or modules; an exercise left to the reader is to explore more about this feature rich shading language.

html: _BLAS 改装具有质量成本。 虽然 BLAS 改装比完全重建快得多，但 BVH 树结构针对静止姿势几何体进行了优化，并且随着网格从该静止姿势进一步变形而逐渐变得不太理想。在极端情况下（角色执行非常大、快速的运动），这可能会导致光线遍历性能降低。一种常见的制作技术是偶尔发出完整的 BLAS 重建（每 N 帧，或当骨架移动超过阈值时），同时对之间的帧使用改装。
source: __VT00000__BLAS refits have quality costs.__VT00001__ While BLAS refits are much faster than full rebuilds, the BVH tree structure is optimized for the rest-pose geometry and becomes progressively less optimal as the mesh deforms further from that rest pose. In extreme cases (characters performing very large, fast motions), this can lead to reduced ray traversal performance. A common production technique is to occasionally issue a full BLAS rebuild (every N frames, or when the skeleton moves beyond a threshold) while using refits for the frames in between.

html: Tanh 解决了另一个问题：ReLU 及其变体的不对称性。ReLU 系列函数始终输出非负值（或者对于 Leaky ReLU 来说大部分为非负值）。这就产生了一个微妙的问题：如果一层中的所有激活都是正的，则下一层中权重的梯度将全部具有相同的符号。这可能会降低优化效率——网络只能在权重空间中向某些方向移动。
source: Tanh addresses a different issue: the asymmetry of ReLU and its variants. ReLU-family functions always output non-negative values (or mostly non-negative for Leaky ReLU). This creates a subtle problem: if all activations in a layer are positive, the gradients for the weights in the next layer will all have the same sign. This can make optimization less efficient—the network can only move in certain directions through the weight space.

Vertex buffers contain per-vertex attributes such as positions, normals, __VT00000__ coordinates, and color information, while index buffers define how vertices connect to form triangles. html: Vulkan 没有“默认 帧缓冲”的概念，因此它需要一个基础设施来拥有我们将在屏幕上可视化之前渲染的缓冲区。该基础设施称为 交换链 并且必须在 Vulkan 中显式创建。交换链本质上是一个等待呈现到屏幕上的图像队列。我们的应用程序将获取这样的图像来绘制它，然后将其返回到队列。队列的具体工作方式以及从队列中呈现图像的条件取决于 交换链 的设置方式。然而，交换链 的一般用途是使图像的呈现与屏幕的刷新率同步。
source: Vulkan does not have the concept of a "default __VT00000__," hence it requires an infrastructure that will own the buffers we will render to before we visualize them on the screen. This infrastructure is known as the __VT00004____VT00001____VT00005__ and must be created explicitly in Vulkan. The swap chain is essentially a queue of images that are waiting to be presented to the screen. Our application will acquire such an image to draw to it, and then return it to the queue. How exactly the queue works and the conditions for presenting an image from the queue depend on how the __VT00002__ is set up. However, the general purpose of the __VT00003__ is to synchronize the presentation of images with the refresh rate of the screen.

The word "micro" is used precisely: these are not additional geometric triangles that the ray tracer has to traverse. html: 第 1 阶段 — 分类（CPU，每个资源一次）： 对于 alpha 测试网格中的每个三角形以及所选细分级别的每个微三角形，构建器会在微三角形内的多个点（通常在质心或多个抖动位置）对 alpha 纹理 进行采样。它对这些样本进行平均并与阈值进行比较。如果平均 alpha 高于上限阈值（接近 1.0），则微三角形被分类为不透明。如果低于阈值下限（接近 0.0），则将其分类为透明。如果它落在阈值之间，则将其分类为“未知”（特别是“未知-透明”或“未知-不透明”，具体取决于应用程序策略）。输出是一个紧凑的每个微三角形 2 位的阵列——典型的网格有几百千字节。
source: __VT00001__Phase 1 — Classification (CPU, one-time per asset):__VT00002__ For each triangle in an alpha-tested mesh, and for each micro-triangle at the chosen subdivision level, the builder samples the alpha __VT00000__ at several points within the micro-triangle — typically at the centroid or at multiple jittered positions. It averages those samples and compares against a threshold. If the average alpha is above the upper threshold (close to 1.0), the micro-triangle is classified Opaque. If it is below the lower threshold (close to 0.0), it is classified Transparent. If it falls between the thresholds, it is classified Unknown (specifically Unknown-Transparent or Unknown-Opaque, depending on application policy). The output is a compact 2-bit-per-micro-triangle array — a few hundred kilobytes for a typical mesh.

html: 所有这些问题的解决方案是我们称之为 “一次蒙皮，到处使用”的策略。 不是将网格蒙皮作为渲染网格的副作用，而是将网格蒙皮 _first_ 作为专用步骤，并将生成的变形顶点位置存储在 GPU 缓冲区中。然后，光栅器、光线追踪器和物理系统都会从 _same_ 缓冲区中读取数据。每个系统都会看到正确的动画网格，并且我们每帧只进行一次昂贵的变形数学。
source: The solution to all of these problems is a strategy we call __VT00000__"Skin Once, Use Everywhere."__VT00001__ Instead of skinning the mesh as a side effect of rendering it, we skin the mesh __VT00002__first__VT00003__, as a dedicated step, and store the resulting deformed vertex positions in a GPU buffer. The rasterizer, the ray tracer, and the physics system all then read from that __VT00004__same__VT00005__ buffer. Every system sees the correct, animated mesh, and we only do the expensive deformation math once per frame.

html: Alpha 测试是一台发散机。在扭曲中的 32 条阴影光线中，有些可能会击中叶子三角形的不透明区域，有些可能会击中透明区域，有些可能根本不会击中任何叶子。任意命中 着色器 在不同线程的不同三角形上触发。有些线程很快完成其 alpha 检查，而其他线程则由于缓存行为而需要更长的时间。扭曲序列化。执行单元闲置着等待掉队者。GPU 的并行吞吐量优势恰恰在最受伤害的地方消失了。
source: Alpha testing is a divergence machine. Out of 32 shadow rays in a warp, some might hit opaque regions of leaf triangles, some might hit transparent regions, and some might not hit any leaf at all. The any-hit __VT00000__ fires on different triangles for different threads. Some threads finish their alpha check quickly, others take longer due to cache behavior. The warp serializes. Execution units sit idle waiting for stragglers. The GPU’s parallel throughput advantage evaporates precisely where it hurts most.

Modern GPUs are designed to keep as many specialized hardware units—the rasterizers, the compute cores, the fixed-function blit engines—busy as possible. If you tell the GPU to wait at __VT00000__, you are essentially draining the entire pipeline. The GPU must wait until every previous operation is completely finished before it can start even the smallest part of the next operation.

html: 随着 显卡 架构的成熟，它们开始提供越来越多的可编程功能。所有这些新功能都必须以某种方式与现有 API 集成。这导致图形驱动程序方面的抽象不太理想，并且需要进行大量猜测才能将程序员的意图映射到现代图形架构。这就是为什么有如此多的驱动程序更新来提高游戏性能，有时甚至是大幅提升。由于这些驱动程序的复杂性，应用程序开发人员还需要处理供应商之间的不一致问题，例如 shaders 接受的语法。除了这些新功能之外，过去十年还出现了大量具有强大图形硬件的移动和嵌入式设备。这些移动 GPU 根据其能源和空间要求具有不同的架构。一个这样的例子是平铺渲染，通过为程序员提供对此功能的更多控制，它将受益于性能的提高。源自这些 API 时代的另一个限制是有限的多线程支持，这可能会导致 CPU 方面出现瓶颈。
source: As __VT00000__ architectures matured, they started offering more and more programmable functionality. All this new functionality had to be integrated with the existing APIs somehow. This resulted in less than ideal abstractions and a lot of guesswork on the graphics driver side to map the programmer’s intent to the modern graphics architectures. That’s why there are so many driver updates for improving the performance in games, sometimes by significant margins. Because of the complexity of these drivers, application developers also need to deal with inconsistencies between vendors, like the syntax that is accepted for __VT00001__shaders__VT00002__. Aside from these new features, the past decade also saw an influx of mobile and embedded devices with powerful graphics hardware. These mobile GPUs have different architectures based on their energy and space requirements. One such example is __VT00003__tiled rendering__VT00004__, which would benefit from improved performance by offering the programmer more control over this functionality. Another limitation originating from the age of these APIs is limited multi-threading support, which can result in a bottleneck on the CPU side.

html: Linux 使这一机制特别容易理解，因此即使基本原理不是 Linux 特有的，也值得具体命名：内核的 D​​RM/KMS 子系统为每个显示器分发一个“主”租约，并且无论哪个进程持有它（通常情况下是您的合成器），都是唯一允许更改显示模式或直接呈现给硬件的进程。在 Linux 上测试此实现时，根据驱动程序的不同，可以通过两种不同的方式看到效果：专有的 NVIDIA 驱动程序甚至在 Wayland 合成器保持会话时不导出 vkGetPhysicalDeviceDisplayPropertiesKHR 入口点，而 Mesa 的 Intel 驱动程序正常导出该函数，但出于相同的根本原因报告零显示。无论哪种方式，列出物理设备、显示器、模式和平面都不需要拥有显示器，并且通常仍然有效；这是表面创建调用本身，以及它后面的所有内容 - 交换链 创建、演示 - 都会失败，因为坐在你面前的合成器不会仅仅因为第二个应用程序的要求而将显示器的控制权移交给第二个应用程序。
source: Linux makes the mechanics of this particularly easy to see, so it’s worth naming concretely even though the underlying principle isn’t Linux-specific: the kernel’s DRM/KMS subsystem hands out a single "master" lease per display, and whichever process holds it - your compositor, in the normal case - is the only one allowed to change display modes or present directly to the hardware. In testing this implementation on Linux, the effect was visible in two different ways depending on the driver: the proprietary NVIDIA driver didn’t even export the __VT00000__ entry point while a Wayland compositor held the session, while Mesa’s Intel driver exported the function normally but reported zero displays for the same underlying reason. Either way, listing physical devices, displays, modes, and planes doesn’t require owning the display and will generally still work; it’s the surface-creation call itself, and everything that would follow it - __VT00001__ creation, presentation - that fails, because the compositor sitting in front of you isn’t going to hand over control of your monitor to a second application just because it asked.

html: 二进制信号量 要么​​是无信号的，要么是有信号的。它的生命开始时是无信号的。我们使用 二进制信号量 对队列操作进行排序的方法是，在一个队列操作中提供相同的 信号量 作为“信号”信号量，并在另一个队列操作中作为“等待”信号量。例如，假设我们有 信号量 S 和要按顺序执行的队列操作 A 和 B。我们告诉 Vulkan 的是，操作 A 在完成执行时将向 信号量 S 发出“信号”，而操作 B 将在开始执行之前在 信号量 S 上“等待”。当操作 A 完成时，信号量 S 将收到信号，而操作 B 不会开始，直到 S 收到信号。操作 B 开始执行后，信号量 S 自动重置为无信号状态，允许再次使用它。
source: A __VT00000__ is either unsignaled or signaled. It begins life as unsignaled. The way we use a __VT00001__ to order queue operations is by providing the same __VT00002__ as a 'signal' __VT00003__ in one queue operation and as a 'wait' __VT00004__ in another queue operation. For example, let’s say we have __VT00005__ S and queue operations A and B that we want to execute in order. What we tell Vulkan is that operation A will 'signal' __VT00006__ S when it finishes executing, and operation B will 'wait' on __VT00007__ S before it begins executing. When operation A finishes, __VT00008__ S will be signaled, while operation B wont start until S is signaled. After operation B begins executing, __VT00009__ S is automatically reset back to being unsignaled, allowing it to be used again.

html: 密集（全连接）层执行矩阵乘法。如果您的输入是大小为 N 的向量，并且该层有 M 个输出，则需要将 M×N 权重矩阵乘以 N 维输入向量，然后添加 M 维偏差向量。这是经典的矩阵向量乘法，GPU 处理起来非常高效。挑战在于，对于大型层（例如 4096 个输入和 4096 个输出），您需要将 4096×4096 矩阵相乘，即 1600 万次乘加运算。有效地并行化是性能的关键。
source: __VT00000__Dense (Fully Connected) Layers__VT00001__ perform matrix multiplication. If your input is a vector of size N and the layer has M outputs, you’re multiplying an M×N weight matrix by your N-dimensional input vector, then adding an M-dimensional bias vector. This is a classic matrix-vector multiply, which GPUs handle very efficiently. The challenge is that for large layers (say, 4096 inputs and 4096 outputs), you’re multiplying a 4096×4096 matrix, which is 16 million multiply-add operations. Parallelizing this effectively is key to performance.

html: GPU 通过称为 _Bounding Volume Hierarchy_ 或 _BVH_ 的空间数据结构来避免这种情况。想象一下一个文件柜。顶层抽屉包含一个包围整个场景的大盒子。该盒子内有几个较小的盒子，每个盒子都包围了场景的一个主要区域 - 也许是左半部分和右半部分。每个里面都有更小的盒子，进一步细分。在层次结构的底部，每个叶节点包含少量的实际三角形。
source: The GPU avoids this through a spatial data structure called a __VT00000__Bounding Volume Hierarchy__VT00001__, or __VT00002__BVH__VT00003__. Imagine a filing cabinet. The top-level drawer contains a single large box that encloses the entire scene. Inside that box are several smaller boxes, each enclosing a major region of the scene — perhaps the left half and the right half. Inside each of those are still smaller boxes, subdividing further. At the bottom of the hierarchy, each leaf node contains a small number of actual triangles.

html: 两个 Unknown 状态是使 4 状态方案正确且实用的关键。我们可以保守一点，而不是试图提前对每个三角形的每个像素进行完美分类（这将需要无限细分）。当 alpha 纹理 在整个微三角形中明显是实心的时，我们对不透明 (3) 进行编码。如果它明显是空的，我们编码透明（0）。只有在边界区域中，单个微三角形横跨 alpha 截止边缘，我们才承认不确定性并使用两个未知状态之一回落到任意命中 着色器 。未知-透明是树叶的典型选择：该提示使驱动程序偏向于透明度，这与 alpha 边界处的统计期望相匹配。
source: The two Unknown states are the key to making the 4-state scheme both correct and practical. Instead of trying to perfectly classify every pixel of every triangle in advance — which would require infinite subdivision — we can be conservative. Where the alpha __VT00000__ is clearly solid across the entire micro-triangle, we encode Opaque (3). Where it is clearly empty, we encode Transparent (0). Only in the boundary regions, where a single micro-triangle straddles the alpha cutoff edge, do we admit uncertainty and fall back to the any-hit __VT00001__ using one of the two Unknown states. Unknown-Transparent is the typical choice for foliage: the hint biases the driver toward transparency, which matches the statistical expectation at an alpha boundary.

html: GPU执行模型的一个关键规则是工作组原子性：一旦将工作组分配给物理计算单元，其所有调用都将保留在该单元上，直到工作组完成。它们不能拆分到多个单元中。这种局部性使得共享内存（LDS - 本地数据存储）成为可能——由于工作组中的所有线程物理上位于同一硬件块上，因此它们可以共享专用的超快缓存。
source: A critical rule of the GPU execution model is __VT00000__workgroup atomicity__VT00001__: once a workgroup is assigned to a physical compute unit, all its invocations will stay on that unit until the workgroup completes. They cannot be split across multiple units. This locality is what enables __VT00002__Shared Memory (LDS - Local Data Store)__VT00003__—since all threads in a workgroup are physically on the same hardware block, they can share a dedicated, ultra-fast cache.

html: _2 状态格式 (VK_OPACITY_MICROMAP_FORMAT_2_STATE_EXT) 每个微三角形存储一位。每个微三角形要么是透明的 (0)，要么是不透明的 (1)。这种二进制分类是最简单的模型：不会调用 着色器 — 硬件根据存储的位立即提交或丢弃每个命中。当您完全控制 alpha 内容并且可以保证没有微三角形真正跨越 alpha 边界，或者当您愿意接受强制二元分类带来的小视觉误差时，2 状态格式是理想的选择。

This binary classification is the simplest possible model: no __VT00001__ is ever invoked — hardware immediately commits or discards every hit based on the stored bit. html: 该过程的输出是一个紧凑的 2 位值数组（对于 4 状态格式）：每个微三角形一个。不透明编码为 3，透明编码为 0，未知透明编码为 1，未知不透明编码为 2。对于大多数树叶，未知透明 (1) 用于边界微三角形：它让任意命中 着色器 进行最终调用，同时暗示结果更有可能是透明的。对于细分级别为 3、具有 10,000 个叶三角形的网格，微图数据为 10,000 个微三角形乘以 64 个微三角形乘以 2 位，约为 160 KB。使用 2 状态格式可将其减半至大约 80 KB，但代价是完全消除任意命中回退。与网格数据本身相比，此内存占用可以忽略不计。
source: The output of this process is a compact array of 2-bit values (for the 4-state format): one per micro-triangle. Opaque is encoded as 3, Transparent as 0, Unknown-Transparent as 1, and Unknown-Opaque as 2. For most foliage, Unknown-Transparent (1) is used for boundary micro-triangles: it lets the any-hit __VT00000__ make the final call while hinting that the outcome is more likely transparent. For a mesh with 10,000 leaf triangles at subdivision level 3, the micromap data is 10,000 times 64 micro-triangles times 2 bits, which is about 160 kilobytes. Using the 2-state format halves this to approximately 80 kilobytes, at the cost of eliminating the any-hit fallback entirely. This memory footprint is negligible compared to the mesh data itself.

html: 法线贴图代表了现代实时渲染中最强大的技术之一，使我们能够在不增加几何复杂性的情况下添加高频表面细节。通过将表面扰动作为 RGB 值存储在 纹理 中，我们可以模拟划痕、铆钉或织物编织等精细细节，而用实际几何模型进行建模的成本高昂。神奇的事情发生在切线空间中，我们从切线-双切线-法线 (TBN) 矩阵重建扰动法线向量 N，确保照明计算对这些小尺度表面特征做出响应，就好像它们是真实的几何细节一样。- 环境光遮挡 (AO)：减弱全局模型未捕获的缝隙中的间接光。我们将环境/IBL 项乘以 AO 以避免过于平坦的着色。- 自发光：让材料独立于照明（例如 LED、屏幕）而发光，并做出附加贡献，因此即使在黑暗中也能看到。
source: Normal mapping represents one of the most powerful techniques in modern real-time rendering, allowing us to add high-frequency surface detail without increasing geometric complexity. By storing surface perturbations as RGB values in a __VT00000__, we can simulate fine details like scratches, rivets, or fabric weaves that would be prohibitively expensive to model with actual geometry. The magic happens in tangent space, where we reconstruct the perturbed normal vector N from the tangent-bitangent-normal (TBN) matrix, ensuring that lighting calculations respond to these small-scale surface features as if they were real geometric details. - Ambient occlusion (AO): Dampens indirect light in crevices the global model doesn’t capture. We multiply the ambient/IBL term by AO to avoid overly flat shading. - Emissive: Lets materials glow independent of lighting (e.g., LEDs, screens) and contributes additively so it’s visible even in darkness.

html: 如果您曾经尝试用直接解析公式来解决这个问题，您很快就会发现问题。对于两根骨头链（想想：带有肩膀和肘部的简单手臂），有一个封闭形式的解决方案 - 它涉及一些三角学，并产生两个解决方案（肘部向上或肘部向下），或者如果目标超出范围则不产生解决方案。但对于三骨链或五骨脊柱来说，不存在干净的闭合形式。系统变得_under确定：自由度（旋转轴）比约束（目标的三个坐标）更多，这意味着将末端执行器放置在目标处的姿势有无限多个，我们需要一种算法来从中进行选择。
source: If you have ever tried to solve this with a direct analytical formula, you quickly discover the problem. For a two-bone chain (think: a simple arm with a shoulder and elbow), there is a closed-form solution—it involves a bit of trigonometry and produces either two solutions (elbow up or elbow down) or no solution if the target is out of reach. But for a three-bone chain, or a five-bone spine, there is no clean closed form. The system becomes __VT00000__underdetermined__VT00001__: there are more degrees of freedom (rotation axes) than constraints (the three coordinates of the target), which means there are infinitely many poses that place the end effector at the target, and we need an algorithm to pick among them.

For each micro-triangle, it computes the barycentric coordinates of the micro-triangle’s centroid within the original triangle. From those coordinates, it interpolates the triangle’s UV coordinates to find the centroid’s position in __VT00000__ space. It then samples the CPU-side alpha __VT00001__ at that UV position.

html: GPU 不是顺序机器。它同时在数百或数千个并行执行单元上执行 着色器 代码。这些单元以名为 _warps_（NVIDIA 术语）或 _wavefronts_（AMD 术语）的组形式工作，通常有 32 或 64 个 着色器 线程以锁步方式执行，同时在不同数据上运行相同的指令。这种大规模并行执行模型就是 GPU 可以对每帧数百万像素进行着色的原因。
source: The GPU is not a sequential machine. It executes __VT00000__ code on hundreds or thousands of parallel execution units simultaneously. This massively parallel execution model is why the GPU can shade millions of pixels per frame.

html: 程序动画是使用算法（而不是艺术家创作的关键帧）在运行时生成或修改关节变换的学科。游戏中最重要的应用是逆向运动学(IK)：我们不是直接对脚的位置进行动画处理，而是从我们希望脚着地的位置计算必要的关节角度。这使得角色能够将脚正确地放置在不平坦的地形上，接触到不在动画师预期的确切位置的物体，并以看起来自然而不是预先设定的方式响应物理事件。
source: Procedural animation is the discipline of generating or modifying joint transforms at runtime using algorithms, rather than artist-authored keyframes. The most important application for games is __VT00000__Inverse Kinematics (IK)__VT00001__: rather than animating the foot’s position directly, we compute the necessary joint angles from where we want the foot to land. This allows characters to place their feet correctly on uneven terrain, to reach for objects that aren’t in the exact position the animator expected, and to respond to physics events in ways that look natural rather than canned.

html: 解决方案是告诉物理引擎哪对物体应该 _not_ 相互碰撞。这称为碰撞过滤。物理引擎使用位掩码来实现它：每个物体属于一个或多个碰撞组，并且每个物体都有一个碰撞掩码来指定允许它与哪些组发生碰撞。如果第一个物体的组位设置在第二个物体的掩码中，则两个物体只会产生碰撞接触，反之亦然。
source: The solution is to tell the physics engine which pairs of bodies should __VT00000__not__VT00001__ collide with each other. This is called __VT00002__collision filtering__VT00003__. Physics engines implement it using bitmasks: each body belongs to one or more __VT00004__collision groups__VT00005__, and each body has a __VT00006__collision mask__VT00007__ that specifies which groups it is allowed to collide with. Two bodies will only generate collision contacts if the first body’s group bit is set in the second body’s mask, and vice versa.

html: 另一方面，许多笔记本电脑和移动设备使用 统一内存架构 (UMA)，其中 CPU 和 GPU 共享相同的物理 RAM 棒。虽然这听起来应该会让事情变得更容易，但它实际上增加了一个隐藏的复杂层：_Caches_。即使它们共享 RAM，CPU 也有自己的 L1/L2/L3 缓存，GPU 也有自己的 L1/L2 缓存。如果 GPU 将数据写入共享缓冲区，该数据可能会保留在 GPU 的 L2 缓存中，而永远不会真正到达物理 RAM。当 CPU 尝试读取它时，它会从 RAM 或其自己的缓存中看到旧的、过时的值。
source: On the other hand, many laptops and mobile devices use __VT00000__Unified Memory Architecture (UMA)__VT00001__, where the CPU and GPU share the same physical RAM sticks. While this sounds like it should make things easier, it actually adds a hidden layer of complexity: __VT00002__Caches__VT00003__. Even if they share the RAM, the CPU has its own L1/L2/L3 caches, and the GPU has its own L1/L2 caches. If the GPU writes data to a shared buffer, that data might stay in the GPU’s L2 cache and never actually reach the physical RAM. When the CPU tries to read it, it will see the old, stale value from the RAM or its own cache.

html: Vulkan API 是围绕最小驱动程序开销的理念而设计的，该目标的表现之一是默认情况下 API 中的错误检查非常有限。即使是像将枚举设置为不正确的值或将空指针传递给所需参数这样简单的错误，通常也不会在 C++ 类型检查之外进行显式处理，并且只会导致崩溃或未定义的行为。由于 Vulkan 要求您对所做的一切都非常明确，因此很容易犯许多小错误，例如使用新的 GPU 功能并忘记在 逻辑设备 创建时请求它。
source: The Vulkan API is designed around the idea of minimal driver overhead, and one of the manifestations of that goal is that there is very limited error checking in the API by default. Even mistakes as simple as setting enumerations to incorrect values or passing null pointers to required parameters are generally not explicitly handled beyond c++ type checking, and will simply result in crashes or undefined behavior. Because Vulkan requires you to be very explicit about everything you’re doing, it’s easy to make many small mistakes like using a new GPU feature and forgetting to request it at __VT00000__ creation time.

html: 了解它在 Windows 上的具体工作原理也很重要，因此值得具体说明相同的故事在 Windows 中如何发挥作用，因为即使结果相同，机制看起来也不同。自 Windows 8 起，Windows 就不允许禁用其桌面合成器 DWM - 与 Windows 7 不同，您可以在 Windows 7 中关闭 Aero，但没有面向用户的方法可以将标准 Windows 桌面、Pro 或 Enterprise 会话降至“没有任何内容合成此显示”，就像 Linux 控制台允许您完全放弃合成器一样。DWM 始终是您在这些版本上拥有显示器的东西。因此，想要严格控制显示器呈现的 Windows 开发人员几乎总是会使用 VK_EXT_full_screen_exclusive 而不是 VK_KHR_display：这是与 DWM 的协商，您的 交换链 要求独占全屏访问，而 DWM 会为其让步，而不是像 VK_KHR_display 那样尝试夺取原始扫描输出控制。VK_KHR_display 本身并不与 Vulkan 规范中的任何特定平台绑定，因此 Windows 驱动程序可以自由地公开它，但在普通的 Windows 桌面会话中，您将遇到与上面的 Wayland 合成器相同的代码 - DWM 首先在那里，并且它不会因为第二个应用程序要求得很好而放弃您的屏幕所有权。VK_KHR_display 真正适用于 Windows 的地方更接近于根本不运行完整桌面 shell 的嵌入式和物联网部署，与同等的无头 Linux 故事相比，这在 Windows 世界中所占的份额要小得多。
source: Understanding how this works concretely for Windows is also important, so it’s worth being specific about how the same story plays out there, because the mechanics look different even though the outcome is the same. Windows has not allowed its desktop compositor, DWM, to be disabled since Windows 8 - unlike Windows 7, where you could turn Aero off, there is no user-facing way to get a standard Windows desktop, Pro, or Enterprise session down to "nothing is compositing this display" the way a Linux console lets you switch away from a compositor entirely. DWM is simply always the thing that owns your monitor on those editions. Because of that, Windows developers who want tight control over a display’s presentation almost always reach for __VT00000__ rather than __VT00001__: it’s a negotiation with DWM, where your __VT00005__ asks for exclusive fullscreen access and DWM steps aside for it, rather than an attempt to seize raw scanout control the way __VT00002__ does. __VT00003__ itself isn’t tied to any particular platform in the Vulkan spec, so a Windows driver is free to expose it, but on an ordinary Windows desktop session you’ll hit the same wall this code hit against the Wayland compositor above - DWM was there first, and it isn’t giving up ownership of your screen because a second application asked nicely. Where __VT00004__ genuinely applies on Windows is closer to embedded and IoT deployments that don’t run the full desktop shell at all, which is a much smaller slice of the Windows world than the equivalent headless-Linux story.

html: “经典”的基于 CPU 的粒子系统会将粒子数据存储在系统的主内存中，然后使用 CPU 来更新它们。更新后，顶点需要再次传输到GPU内存中，以便在下一帧中显示更新后的粒子。最直接的方法是使用每帧的新数据重新创建 顶点缓冲区。这是非常昂贵的。根据您的实现，还有其他选项，例如映射 GPU 内存，以便 CPU 可以写入。（在桌面系统上称为“可调整大小的 BAR”，或在集成 GPU 上称为统一内存）或仅使用主机本地缓冲区（由于 PCI-E 带宽，这将是最慢的方法）。但无论您选择哪种缓冲区更新方法，您始终需要与 CPU 进行“往返”来更新粒子。
source: The "classical" CPU-based particle system would store particle data in the system’s main memory and then use the CPU to update them. After the update, the vertices need to be transferred to the GPU’s memory again so it can display the updated particles in the next frame. The most straight-forward way would be recreating the __VT00000__ with the new data for each frame. This is very costly. Depending on your implementation, there are other options like mapping GPU memory so it can be written by the CPU. (Called "resizable BAR" on desktop systems, or unified memory on integrated GPUs) or just using a host local buffer (which would be the slowest method due to PCI-E bandwidth). But no matter what buffer update method you choose, you always require a "round-trip" to the CPU to update the particles.
